author: packs
description: D25-T6: win and loss analysis reports: overall win rate, win rate and reasons by competitor, reasons by segment, region and size, discount and sales cycle by competitor, losses on price by discount band, and win rate by quarter. A deal counts against a competitor when it was lost to it or the competitor is on the deal.
name: sales-win-loss

definition.name: Sales: Win Rate Overall
definition.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.stage = 'closed_won') AS won, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.stage = 'closed_lost') AS lost, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount) FILTER (WHERE o.stage = 'closed_won'), 0) AS won_amount, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount) FILTER (WHERE o.stage = 'closed_lost'), 0) AS lost_amount, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.stage = 'closed_won') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.stage = 'closed_won' OR o.stage = 'closed_lost'), 0), 1) AS win_rate_percent FROM opportunity o WHERE o.stage IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost') AND (o.is_active IS NULL OR o.is_active = true)

definition.name: Sales: Win Rate by Competitor
definition.sql: SELECT d.competitor_ref, d.competitor_name, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.stage = 'closed_won') AS won, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.stage = 'closed_lost') AS lost, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(d.stage, '') NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost')) AS open, COALESCE(SUM(d.amount) FILTER (WHERE d.stage = 'closed_won'), 0) AS won_amount, COALESCE(SUM(d.amount) FILTER (WHERE d.stage = 'closed_lost'), 0) AS lost_amount, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.stage = 'closed_won') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.stage = 'closed_won' OR d.stage = 'closed_lost'), 0), 1) AS win_rate_percent FROM (SELECT c.id AS competitor_ref, c.name AS competitor_name, o.id AS opportunity_ref, o.stage, o.amount, o.deal_discount_percent, o.close_date, o.created_at FROM competitor c JOIN opportunity o ON (o.lost_to_competitor_ref = c.id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opportunity_competitor oc WHERE oc.opportunity_ref = o.id AND oc.competitor_ref = c.id AND (oc.is_active IS NULL OR oc.is_active = true))) WHERE (c.is_active IS NULL OR c.is_active = true) AND (o.is_active IS NULL OR o.is_active = true)) d GROUP BY d.competitor_ref, d.competitor_name

definition.name: Sales: Win-Loss Reasons by Competitor
definition.sql: SELECT d.competitor_ref, d.competitor_name, r.outcome, r.main_reason, COUNT(*) AS reviews, COALESCE(SUM(d.amount), 0) AS amount FROM (SELECT c.id AS competitor_ref, c.name AS competitor_name, o.id AS opportunity_ref, o.stage, o.amount, o.deal_discount_percent, o.close_date, o.created_at FROM competitor c JOIN opportunity o ON (o.lost_to_competitor_ref = c.id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opportunity_competitor oc WHERE oc.opportunity_ref = o.id AND oc.competitor_ref = c.id AND (oc.is_active IS NULL OR oc.is_active = true))) WHERE (c.is_active IS NULL OR c.is_active = true) AND (o.is_active IS NULL OR o.is_active = true)) d JOIN win_loss_review r ON r.opportunity_ref = d.opportunity_ref AND (r.is_active IS NULL OR r.is_active = true) WHERE r.main_reason IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.competitor_ref, d.competitor_name, r.outcome, r.main_reason

definition.name: Sales: Win-Loss Reasons by Segment, Region and Size
definition.sql: SELECT a.industry AS segment, a.territory_ref AS region_ref, a.employee_band AS size_band, r.outcome, r.main_reason, COUNT(*) AS reviews, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) AS amount FROM win_loss_review r JOIN opportunity o ON o.id = r.opportunity_ref AND (o.is_active IS NULL OR o.is_active = true) LEFT JOIN account a ON a.id = o.account_ref AND (a.is_active IS NULL OR a.is_active = true) WHERE (r.is_active IS NULL OR r.is_active = true) AND r.main_reason IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.industry, a.territory_ref, a.employee_band, r.outcome, r.main_reason

target.query: Sales: Win-Loss Reasons by Segment, Region and Size

definition.name: Sales: Discount and Sales Cycle by Competitor
definition.sql: SELECT d.competitor_ref, d.competitor_name, d.stage AS outcome, COUNT(*) AS deals, ROUND(AVG(d.deal_discount_percent), 1) AS avg_discount_percent, ROUND(AVG(d.close_date::date - d.created_at::date), 1) AS avg_cycle_days FROM (SELECT c.id AS competitor_ref, c.name AS competitor_name, o.id AS opportunity_ref, o.stage, o.amount, o.deal_discount_percent, o.close_date, o.created_at FROM competitor c JOIN opportunity o ON (o.lost_to_competitor_ref = c.id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opportunity_competitor oc WHERE oc.opportunity_ref = o.id AND oc.competitor_ref = c.id AND (oc.is_active IS NULL OR oc.is_active = true))) WHERE (c.is_active IS NULL OR c.is_active = true) AND (o.is_active IS NULL OR o.is_active = true)) d WHERE d.stage IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost') GROUP BY d.competitor_ref, d.competitor_name, d.stage

target.query: Sales: Discount and Sales Cycle by Competitor

definition.name: Sales: Lost on Price by Discount Band
definition.sql: SELECT b.discount_band, COUNT(*) AS closed_deals, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.stage = 'closed_lost') AS lost, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.stage = 'closed_lost' AND b.main_reason = 'price') AS lost_on_price, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.stage = 'closed_lost' AND b.main_reason = 'price') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.stage = 'closed_lost'), 0), 1) AS lost_on_price_percent FROM (SELECT o.stage, r.main_reason, CASE WHEN COALESCE(o.deal_discount_percent, 0) = 0 THEN '0' WHEN o.deal_discount_percent <= 5 THEN '0-5' WHEN o.deal_discount_percent <= 10 THEN '5-10' WHEN o.deal_discount_percent <= 20 THEN '10-20' ELSE '20+' END AS discount_band FROM opportunity o LEFT JOIN win_loss_review r ON r.opportunity_ref = o.id AND (r.is_active IS NULL OR r.is_active = true) WHERE o.stage IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost') AND (o.is_active IS NULL OR o.is_active = true)) b GROUP BY b.discount_band

target.query: Sales: Lost on Price by Discount Band

definition.name: Sales: Win Rate by Quarter
definition.sql: SELECT date_trunc('quarter', o.close_date)::date AS quarter, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.stage = 'closed_won') AS won, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.stage = 'closed_lost') AS lost, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount) FILTER (WHERE o.stage = 'closed_won'), 0) AS won_amount, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.stage = 'closed_won') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.stage = 'closed_won' OR o.stage = 'closed_lost'), 0), 1) AS win_rate_percent FROM opportunity o WHERE o.stage IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost') AND o.close_date IS NOT NULL AND (o.is_active IS NULL OR o.is_active = true) GROUP BY date_trunc('quarter', o.close_date)::date

title: Pack: win and loss analysis
